ACHIEVEMENTS.ENTITIES: Seven entities: employees, positions, contracts, attendance, leave, payroll periods and payslips — full CRUD with role-based permissions.
ACHIEVEMENTS.PROFILE: Employee profile hub with summary (active contract, poste, salary) and tabs for contracts, attendance, leave and payslips.
ACHIEVEMENTS.RULES: Automatic rules: one active contract per employee, unique CIN/CNSS, contract required for attendance and leave, terminated employee closes contracts.
ACHIEVEMENTS.PAYROLL: Tunisia payroll calculation (CNSS 9.68% / 17.07%, CSS 0.5%, progressive IRPP), batch payslip generation, period lifecycle (Open → Calculated → Validated → Paid → Closed), and payslip PDF download.
ACHIEVEMENTS.LEAVE: Leave approval workflow: Approve or Reject pending requests from the leave detail view.
ACHIEVEMENTS.PERMISSIONS: Entity-specific actions beyond CRUD: Approve/Reject leave, Calculate/Validate/Pay/Close payroll, Generate PDF payslips, Export attendance — gated by HR:ENTITY:ACTION permissions.

GUIDE.PERMISSIONS_SUBTITLE: Each screen and row action requires HR:ENTITY:ACTION. Assign role presets in Settings → Users & roles, or grant permissions individually.

GUIDE.ROLES_SUBTITLE: Reference presets in permissions-spec.json — create matching roles in User management:

ROLES.CLERK: HR Clerk — employees, attendance, leave submission (no approve/payroll run)
ROLES.MANAGER: HR Manager — approve leave, manage contracts, employee PDF, full attendance

WORKFLOW.STEP1: Create positions (job titles) under HR → Positions.
WORKFLOW.STEP2: Add employees with identity, hire date and CNSS fields.
WORKFLOW.STEP3: Create employment contracts (employee + position + salary) and set status to Active when in force. CDI contracts have no end date.
WORKFLOW.STEP4: Record daily attendance and submit leave requests; approve pending leave from the detail view.
WORKFLOW.STEP5: Create a payroll period → View → Payslips tab → Generate payslips → review → Advance status until Closed.

GUIDE.EMPLOYEES_BODY: The employee list supports search and filters. Open View to see the profile hub: edit personal data on the Profile tab, or use other tabs to browse linked contracts, attendance, leave and payslips. Use Add on each tab to create a child record with the employee pre-selected. Job title is read-only when an active contract exists (synced from the contract position). Setting status to Terminated closes active contracts.
GUIDE.CONTRACTS_BODY: Each contract links an employee to a position with type (CDI, CDD, etc.), dates and salary. Only one contract can be Active per employee — saving a new active contract expires the previous one. Permanent (CDI) contracts do not require an end date. Activate a contract only when it is legally in force.
GUIDE.PAYROLL_BODY: Create one payroll period per month. On the period view, open the Payslips tab and click Generate payslips to create draft payslips for every employee with an active contract during the period. Amounts are calculated automatically from contract salary plus Tunisia statutory deductions. Advance the period status step by step; Paid and Closed periods lock further edits.
GUIDE.LEAVE_BODY: Employees submit leave with type and date range. The system checks overlap with other pending or approved leave and requires an active contract. HR reviewers open the leave detail view and click Approve or Reject while status is Pending. Approved leave can automatically mark attendance as Leave on matching work dates.
GUIDE.DOCS_HINT: Full technical documentation is also available in docs/user-guide/en/09-hr-module.md in the project repository.
